Who We Are
 We drive innovation – from advisory and implementation to managed services and beyond, powered by a global team of over 18,500 experts representing over 90 nations in more than 30 countries. With SAP at our core and a powerful ecosystem of partners like Microsoft and ServiceNow, we continuously improve solutions and AI-driven technology to make them work for companies – and for their people.
As part of NTT DATA, a $30+ billion business and technology services, AI and digital infrastructure leader. As a Global Top Employer, NTT DATA serves 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and, with experts in over 70 countries, co-innovates solutions that encourage experimentation and recognize great work. With us, you have endless opportunities to think big, act bold and take ownership. Make this the place where you belong, learn, and build your network.
We are looking for a Senior SAP S/4HANA ABAP Cloud Developer with strong logistics development experience to join our Custom Development team.
The role focuses on clean, future-proof ABAP Cloud development in SAP S/4HANA, aligned with SAP Clean Core principles and modern development paradigms such as CDS Views and released APIs.
You will work in an international setup, closely collaborating with onshore architects, functional consultants, and customers.
 What You’ll Be Doing
Design, develop, and maintain ABAP Cloud-compliant solutions in SAP S/4HANA Private and Public Cloud
Implement custom developments primarily in the logistics domain (e.g. MM, SD, PP – depending on project context)
Develop and consume CDS Views as part of modern S/4HANA architectures
Develop modern ABAP RAP applications
Use released APIs, events, and extensibility concepts according to SAP Clean Core guidelines
Analyze business and technical requirements based on standard S/4HANA logistics processes
Ensure high code quality, performance, and long-term maintainability
Support technical design, reviews, testing, and defect analysis
Act as a senior technical counterpart for onshore teams
Participate in technical discussions and solution design sessions in English
 What You’ll Bring Along
Senior-level experience in SAP S/4HANA ABAP development
Strong expertise in: ABAP Cloud development principles (On-Stack)
CDS Views (design, associations, annotations, consumption)
ABAP RAP
Modern S/4HANA development techniques
Solid development experience in SAP logistics processes
Proven understanding of SAP Clean Core strategy and extensibility concepts
Experience with: Eclipse and ABAP Development Tools (ADT), Released APIs
On-Stack and In-App extensibility (depending on project setup)
Experience in SAP S/4HANA projects is mandatory
SAP Certification "Backend Developer - ABAP Cloud (C_ABAPD)" is a plus
Structured, quality-oriented, and responsible working style
Strong communication skills and senior team mindset
English language skills at least Level B2 (spoken and written)
German language skills would be an advantage
